title: Goemans's Unsplittable-Flow Conjecture: The Anatomy of AI-Assisted Counterexample Discovery
abstract: arXiv:2611.23244v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Goemans conjectured that any fractional single-source flow could be converted into an unsplittable flow without increasing total cost and while increasing any arc load by at most the largest demand. Recently, Dmitry Rybin announced a seven-vertex counterexample found through an interaction with ChatGPT, which disproved this long-standing conjecture. However, the interaction did not reveal why this particular topology and its demand, fractional-flow, and cost choices work together, whether the example belongs to a broader family, or which structural features determine where counterexamples can occur. It also left unclear why the AI-assisted search succeeded where earlier human efforts had not. In this paper, we develop a forward counterexample construction pipeline. It starts from an arborescence on which failure is impossible and adds terminal-entering shortcut arcs. The resulting load constraints define a finite set of admissible rout

translated_title: Goemans不可分割流猜想：AI辅助反例发现的解剖分析
translated_abstract: Goemans猜想指出，任何分数单源流都可以转化为不可分割流，且不增加总成本，同时任何弧的负载增加至多不超过最大需求。最近，Dmitry Rybin宣布了一个通过与ChatGPT交互发现的七顶点反例，推翻了这一长期存在的猜想。然而，这一交互并未揭示为什么这种特定的拓扑结构及其需求、分数流和成本选择能够协同发挥作用，该反例是否属于一个更广泛的家族，或者哪些结构特征决定了反例可能出现的位置。这也未能解释为什么AI辅助搜索在此前人类努力失败之处取得了成功。在本文中，我们开发了一个前向反例构造流程。该流程从一个不可能发生失败的树形图出发，并添加进入终点的捷径弧，由此产生的负载约束定义了一个有限的可行路由集合……
tldr: 本文开发了一个前向反例构造流程，系统剖析了AI辅助发现的Goemans不可分割流猜想七顶点反例的结构原理，揭示了该反例为何成立、其所属的更广泛反例家族以及决定反例出现位置的关键结构特征。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a forward counterexample construction pipeline that anatomizes the AI-assisted seven-vertex counterexample to Goemans's unsplittable-flow conjecture, explaining why it works, situating it in a broader family of counterexamples, and identifying the structural features that determine where counterexamples can occur.
